method: Batch 86. Same double and record fields as village-fight-b85-reference.json, plus `bright`, `patches` and `poison` (the b38 layout: a pigman row target is its entityToAttack). Mobs VZ (a villager and a zombie) and a far player; `kill` records: a scripted 17.0 causeMobDamage blow by the zombie at tick 1 leaves the villager on 3 health and the zombie's own AttackOnCollide hit kills it; `blow` records: a scripted lethal causeMobDamage hit by the zombie at tick 5. EntityLivingBase.onDeath calls the killer's onKillEntity (yq.a(sv)): on Normal the killer's nextBoolean (logged b) decides, on Hard the villager is always replaced by a new EntityZombie (copyLocationAndAnglesFrom, World.removeEntity, onSpawnWithEgg, setVillager, spawnEntityInWorld: `conversions`, `zombies`), on Easy it is never. `pigman` records: a zombie pigman (EntityPigZombie, the b38 legacy-row layout with `bright`) angered by a player hit at tick 5, striking the held player, killed by a player hit at tick 50 (recentlyHit drops and deathTime 20 orbs in `loot`). `pigman` records (the b38 legacy-row layout with `bright`): a bare zombie pigman (EntityPigZombie) angered by a player hit at tick 5 strikes the player, which is held in place, and a player hit at tick 50 kills it; `loot` has the recentlyHit drops and the deathTime 20 orbs. The kill records stand in a 2x1 cell walled two high with stone (penned, so the villager cannot flee).
